jds.label: NCS Australia — Senior Full Stack Engineer, AI and Conversational Systems
jds.text:
Senior Full Stack Engineer — AI and Conversational Systems
NCS Australia · Sydney (hybrid)

About the role
NCS Australia is looking for a hands-on Senior Full Stack Engineer to build AI Coach solutions and real-time CoPilot streaming experiences for our enterprise clients. You will work with generative AI features in production, including intelligent agent workflows built on Google's stack: Vertex AI, Dialogflow CX and AgentStudio.

Essential
- Solid experience building production-grade web applications with React, Vite and Tailwind; component libraries documented in Storybook
- Real-time experience: WebSockets, streaming UX for CoPilot-style interactions
- Backend development with Node.js and TypeScript; Java experience in an enterprise API gateway context (Apigee)
- Building and evaluating generative AI features: prompt design, guardrails, testing non-deterministic model behaviour, prompt regression
- Full Australian working rights; Sydney-based or willing to work hybrid from our Sydney office

Desirable
- Vertex AI, Dialogflow CX, AgentStudio
- Experience with AI quality programs: accuracy, latency, guardrails, evaluation
- Cross-functional work with product managers, AI architects, UX designers and platform engineers

Qualifications & other requirements
- Relevant tertiary qualification or equivalent experience
- Background checks: probity, police check

Our values: Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, Unity.
